brief.headline: Push for a 10–15% price cut: they keep 8.5% profit vs. 4.8% for similar firms, and the market shows room to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at volume.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for 10–15% off on the PP caps and similar items
priceAsk.target: ₹0.65–0.80/pc for the 28 mm induction-wad PP cap at higher volume
priceAsk.basis: The open market shows these caps asking ₹0.55–1.20/pc, typically ₹0.85–0.95/pc, with modest headroom to ₹0.65–0.80/pc at higher volume or looser specs. They also keep 8.5% of sales as profit, almost double the 4.8% that similar packaging firms keep — so there's room in their price.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹2.15 L cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: Triveni is healthy: they keep 8.5% of sales as profit (vs. 4.8% for similar firms), carry no debt (0.00x), and easily cover any interest (75.84x). Their cash is stuck for 124 days — longer than the 114 days typical for peers — so they wait longer to collect money than they wait to pay bills. But at ₹26.17 L, we're only 0.15% of their ₹179.69 Cr sales, so on our own we have little pull. The play: bundle more volume or a longer commitment, name the alternates (Manjushree, Mold-Tek, Hitech), and push firmly on price and payment — their profit cushion means a cut won't hurt them.

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter — pharma bottles, caps, preforms. Top second-source candidate. Revenue ₹2569.83 Cr, health B (65/100).

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (pails, containers, pharma); strong, profitable — a robust alternate for bottles/closures.

alternates.name: Hitech Corporation Ltd
alternates.why: Listed moulded & blow-moulded packaging; broad capability across bottles/caps.

risks: We're tiny at 0.15% of their sales — they may not move much unless we bundle more volume or a multi-year deal.
They flagged EPF payment delays — watch whether supply or quality slip if we squeeze too hard.
Their cash flow was ₹-6.59 Cr last year — if things tighten, they may dig in on payment terms rather than give ground.
Market asks vary widely (₹0.55–1.20/pc) — pin down the exact spec, MOQ and lead-time before you lock a target price.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about getting closer to the ₹0.65–0.80 market line on these caps and moving to 30-day payment — the market shows there's room, and we're looking at Manjushree and Mold-Tek as second sources.
